---
title: "Question 5: Compare Economic Measures"
format: dashboard
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(lubridate)

# Built-in U.S. economic data, so no separate CSV file is needed
data(economics, package = "ggplot2")
econ <- economics
econ_long <- econ |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pce, psavert, uempmed, unemploy),
               names_to = "measure", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(measure = recode(measure,
    pce = "Personal consumption spending (millions of dollars)",
    psavert = "Personal savings rate (percent)",
    uempmed = "Median unemployment duration (weeks)",
    unemploy = "People unemployed (thousands)"))
```

## {.sidebar}

### Choose measures

```{r}
checkboxGroupInput("measures", "Show these measures", choices = unique(econ_long$measure), selected = unique(econ_long$measure)[1:2])
```

Check one or more series to compare them.

## Trends

### Row {height=65%}

```{r}
plotlyOutput("trend")
```

### Row {height=35%}

```{r}
DTOutput("data_table")
```

## Data view

### Row {height=100%}

```{r}
plotlyOutput("second_plot")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
filtered <- reactive(filter(econ_long, measure %in% input$measures))
output$trend <- renderPlotly({
  p <- ggplot(filtered(), aes(date, value, color = measure)) + geom_line() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Value (scales differ by measure)", color = "Measure") + theme_minimal()
  ggplotly(p)
})
output$second_plot <- renderPlotly({
  p <- ggplot(filtered(), aes(measure, value, fill = measure)) + geom_boxplot() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Value", title = "Spread of selected measures") + theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none")
  ggplotly(p)
})
output$data_table <- renderDT({ datatable(filtered(), options = list(pageLength = 8)) })
```
